Dashboard.title: GPRS Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Consolidated view across all pharmacies — sales, purchase, stock, and finance.

overview.totalSalesDesc: Sum of the amount on every Sales Register line for the selected branches and date range. Returns (negative-amount lines) are included, so a return reduces this total.
overview.totalPurchaseDesc: Sum of the amount on every Purchase Register line for the selected filters.
overview.stockValueDesc: Sum of each item's stock value, taken only from each branch's most recent Stock Register upload — older uploads are ignored so stock is never double-counted.
overview.collectionDesc: Sum of daily bill value from your Day-Wise Sale imports, for the selected date range — a separate source from the Sales Register.
overview.nearExpiryBatchesDesc: Count of stock batches, from the latest Stock Register upload, whose expiry date falls within the next 30 days.
overview.nonMovingItemsDesc: Count of stock items with zero matching Sales Register lines at all for this branch — never sold since data was first imported.
overview.dailyCollectionTrendDesc: Day-wise bill value over time, straight from your Day-Wise Sale imports — one point per day, independent of the Sales Register.
overview.salesVsPurchaseDesc: The same Total Sales and Total Purchase figures shown above, plotted side by side for quick comparison.
overview.branchWiseSalesDesc: Total sales amount per branch — same calculation as Total Sales, just broken down by branch and ranked highest first.

sales.topItemsBySalesDesc: Items ranked by total sales amount from the Sales Register, for the currently applied filters — the same figures the Sales report is built from, top 10 only.
sales.topReturnsDesc: Items with the highest returned amount (negative-amount Sales Register lines) for the currently applied filters.
sales.salesByCompanyDesc: Sales amount grouped by company (via the item's matched Stock record) — showing only the 8 highest-value companies. Returns are excluded so they don't distort it.
sales.emptyText: No sales data — import a Sales Register file first.

purchase.topSuppliersDesc: Supplier groups ranked by total purchase amount from the Purchase Register, for the currently applied filters.
purchase.freeQtyBySupplierDesc: Free quantity received per supplier group, from the same top-10 Purchase Register data as the chart above.
purchase.purchaseByCompanyDesc: Purchase amount grouped by company (via the item's matched Stock record) — showing only the 8 highest-value companies.
purchase.emptyText: No purchase data — import a Purchase Register file first.

finance.topItemsByGpDesc: Estimated profit per item: sales amount minus (average stock cost price × quantity sold). Cost price is averaged across whatever stock batches exist for that item, so this is an approximation, not the exact cost of the units actually sold.
finance.topItemsByGpPctDesc: The same estimated profit calculation, re-ranked by margin percentage instead of absolute amount — computed over the top 200 items by sales amount, so a near-zero-sales item can't dominate the list with a distorted percentage.
finance.emptyText: No gross profit data — import Sales and Stock files first.

stock.stockValueDesc: Sum of stock value from each branch's latest Stock Register upload, after the filters above are applied.
stock.uniqueItemsDesc: Count of distinct item names in stock after filters — one item can still span several batches/rows.
stock.zeroOrderAlertsDesc: Count of items currently in stock (any quantity) that had zero units sold in the selected period — worth checking before reordering.
stock.expiringSoonDesc: Stock value of batches, from the latest upload, whose expiry date falls within the next 30 days.
stock.nonMovingValueDesc: Stock value of items with no matching Sales Register line at all — never sold since import began.
stock.stockValueByCompanyDesc: Stock value summed and grouped by company — showing only the 8 highest-value companies.
stock.stockHealthDesc: Item count grouped into 5 buckets by current stock quantity: Zero, 1–5, 6–20, 21–50, and 50+ units.
stock.zeroOrderReorderDesc: The top-selling items by quantity sold in the period that currently show zero units in stock.
stock.expiryValueAtRiskDesc: Stock value grouped by how soon it expires: Expired, ≤30 days, 31–90 days, and 91–180 days out.
stock.nonMovingByValueDesc: Non-moving items (zero sales ever recorded) ranked by their stock value, highest first.
stock.topByValueDesc: Items ranked by stock value (summed across batches/branches for the filters above) — highest first.
stock.emptyText: No stock data — import a Stock Register file first.

sales.title: Sales Report
sales.description: Party/item-wise sales detail, one row per line item — same shape as Purchase and Stock, not aggregated.
sales.emptyText: No sales data — import a Sales Register file first.

stock.title: Stock Report
stock.description: Current stock by batch, across branches.
stock.searchPlaceholder: Search by item, code, batch, rack no...
stock.emptyText: No stock data — import a Stock Register file first.

purchase.title: Purchase Report
purchase.description: Item-wise purchase detail, including the scheme % implied by free quantity received on each line.
purchase.emptyText: No purchase data — import a Purchase Register file first.

daySales.title: Day-Wise Sales
daySales.description: Daily bill totals exactly as reported by Marg's Day-Wise Sale export. Independent of the Stock/Purchase/Sales import pipeline — never summed with those reports.
daySales.emptyText: No Day-Wise Sale data — import a Day-Wise Sale file first.

nonMoving.title: Non-Moving Items
nonMoving.description: Stock items with no matching Sales Register line at all — never sold since data was first imported.
nonMoving.searchPlaceholder: Search by item, code, batch, rack no...
nonMoving.emptyText: No non-moving items for the selected filters.

grossProfit.title: Gross Profit Report
grossProfit.description: Estimated profit per item: sales amount minus (average stock cost price × quantity sold). An approximation, not the exact cost of the units actually sold.
grossProfit.emptyText: No gross profit data — import Sales and Stock files first.

Import.title: Import Data
Import.description: Upload the daily Excel exports from Marg, one calendar day at a time: Stock, then Purchase, then Sales, in that order. Day-Wise Sale is independent and can be uploaded any time.
Import.branchPlaceholder: Select the branch to import against
Import.selectBranchDescription: Choose the branch above to start importing files against it.
Import.noImportsYet: No {title} imports yet for this branch
Import.getStarted: Upload Stock to get started for this branch.
Import.cycleComplete: {date} is fully imported — ready for the next date's Stock.
Import.cyclePending: Stock done for {date} — now upload {pending} for that date.

stockRegister.title: Stock Register
stockRegister.description: Item-wise current stock, batches, expiry, cost/sale price — must be for a single day.

purchaseRegister.title: Purchase Register
purchaseRegister.description: Supplier/item-wise purchases — must be for a single day, and Stock must already be uploaded for that date.

salesRegister.title: Sales Register
salesRegister.description: Party/item-wise sales — must be for a single day, and Stock must already be uploaded for that date.

dayWiseSale.title: Day-Wise Sale (Sales Book)
dayWiseSale.description: Daily bill totals — independent of the pipeline above, can span any date range.

Import.bulkUploadSubtitle: Select several Stock/Purchase/Sales/Day-Wise Sale files at once — each file's type is detected automatically. Every file must still be for a single day.
Import.bulkUploadDropzoneTitle: Drag files here, or click to browse
Import.bulkUploadDropzoneHint: .xls or .xlsx — any mix of Stock, Purchase, Sales, Day-Wise Sale
Import.bulkUploadProcessing: {count} file(s) received — processing in the background
